BIT模型端到端脑语解码刷新纪录：词错率从24.69%降至10.22%
传统脑机接口依赖RNN和n-gram逐级拼接，难以联合优化。BIT用跨物种预训练Transformer编码器学习367小时神经数据特征，再将脑波作为“异星音频”接入Audio-LLM。在Brain-to-Text 2024测试集，词错率从24.69%降至10.22…

Great to be at the iBCI-CC Annual Meeting with my @Paradromics friends and colleagues Lydia Hancock, VP of Regulatory Affairs, and Marie Fahey, Director of Clinical Affairs.

Important discussions on clinical trial endpoints, regulatory standards, and building the pathways needed https://t.co/BrUcIpO1v9
イーロンさぁ、クルマやロボもいいけどBCIも頼むよ。

Pumping iron! 💪 using a non-invasive BCI headset (@neurosity crown) I’ve programmed my @UnitreeRobotics R1 EDU to raise its arm when I think of raising my arm. Working on separating right arm / left arm signals. Then next up: we walk & run 😃 https://t.co/gLrwsTr4jB

It’d be funny if we thought we weren’t already living symbiotically with machines. Our personal devices do act as extensions of our intelligence and memory.

So BCI isn’t meant to create that symbiosis, but to greatly increase the speed at which we communicate with machines.

I truly believe that BCI is being used for spying purposes and the information I have can prove that it could be implanted into somebody without their knowledge. They would be able to see exactly what the spied upon person sees. More follows #BCI #conspiracy #espionage #UK 🇬🇧 https://t.co/fQL91IrQTv
Potentially a big unlock for the EEG data bottleneck in non-invasive BCI https://t.co/CDA7fj5bzS

Things not readily available on information about the #BCI systems available globally, what imaging is allowed / not allowed. @grok was able to share some information; but it is interesting how little is till being shared about these devices and how they are operating in the https://t.co/9mwrdy9rux

Alright everyone here is ELON CHRON for Friday, October 16th. If you are at the Bayou Gumbo Launch tomorrow, I will see you there. I will do a Starbase Louisiana flight first.

Have a great weekend, everyone, and please subscribe to support the content, https://t.co/0gOhz3GEiO
